title: Frappe ERPNext 7.1.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 7.1.0 before 15.121.0 and 16.x before 16.34.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Projects module. This flaw allows any authenticated user, even those without assigned roles, to access Timesheet data across the organization without proper access restrictions. The vulnerability exposes work and billing details that should be limited to authorized personnel.
